metadata.domain: Autonomous Driving Platform / ADAS / Automotive Electronics

evidence.trl_pathway: All three technologies start at TRL 6-7 and target completion within 2-3 years, which is realistic for near-market technologies; TRL jumps are modest and timelines are reasonable given the mature starting points.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The declared strategy is 시장이익최대 (Market Profit Maximization), which requires completion close to market boom windows, yet all three technologies complete 1.25 to 2.0 years AFTER their respective booms — systematically missing the profit maximization window and acting more like a conservative R&D portfolio.
evidence.competitive_awareness: All three technologies (steer-by-wire, high-voltage connector assembly, camera-ultrasonic sensor fusion) are firmly within the Autonomous Driving/ADAS/Automotive Electronics domain, showing coherent domain focus and reasonable differentiation awareness.
evidence.market_timing: With a mean timing error of 1.58 years and all completions lagging behind boom windows (스테어바이와이어: +1.25yr late, 고전압커넥터: +1.5yr late, 카메라초음파: +2.0yr late), the portfolio systematically misses the ±0.5 year ideal window required for market profit maximization strategy.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: The selected technologies are commercially relevant and patent-active areas within ADAS, but the roadmap provides no explicit evidence of deliberate convergence-zone targeting; alignment appears incidental rather than analytically driven.

strengths: All selected technologies are domain-coherent, firmly within Autonomous Driving/ADAS/Automotive Electronics with no off-domain drift
TRL pathways are realistic — high starting TRLs (6-7) with manageable development windows reduce execution risk
weaknesses: Systematic late completion across all three technologies means the portfolio will miss peak market demand windows under a profit-maximization strategy
The investment horizon is too long for the declared 시장이익최대 strategy; development timelines should be compressed or start dates advanced to align with boom periods
missing_technologies: LiDAR-based perception middleware (higher TRL, strong 2027-2028 market window alignment)
ADAS domain controller / central compute platform (high commercial urgency, fits domain perfectly)
investment_issues: Assigning 카메라-초음파 통합 센서 (lowest strategic fit score of 3.0) to Tier=High while it has the worst timing error suggests misaligned tier prioritization
No budget headroom (100% utilization) leaves zero flexibility for accelerating timelines or pivoting if market windows shift
timing_issues: 스테어바이와이어 다중모드 제어 completes Q1 2028 but boom is Q4 2026 — 1.25 years late, missing prime commercialization window
고전압 커넥터 자동화 조립 completes Q1 2029 but boom is Q3 2027 — 1.5 years late, significant revenue opportunity loss
카메라-초음파 통합 센서 completes Q1 2030 but boom is Q1 2028 — 2.0 years late, the worst timing misalignment in the portfolio
